setup.input_units: native; encoder units are twice the detents

steps.caption: Channel 1 plays a four-step phrase on steps 1-4 (MIDI 60, 62, 64, 65 at velocities 127, 117, 107, 97) through a MIDI device on OUT 1, in C major at 90 BPM with sixteenth-note steps (Rate /1). The Channel editor is open and the Pattern editor has not been opened. On Pattern Velocity the range buttons on row 8 differ from Pattern Note, which has three: here there are two, range-up at (15,8), toward the 127-68 page, and range-down at (16,8), toward the 58-0 page.
steps.title: Starting point

steps.caption: Press Pattern (5,8) three times to open Pattern Velocity. Each row of a step's column is a velocity level, 127 at the top. Tap (4,1). Press Play at (1,8), then Stop: step 4 plays at velocity 127 while steps 1-3 keep 127, 117, 107.
steps.title: Make a strong accent

steps.caption: Tap down the column of step 4 and press Play, then Stop, after each tap: (4,2) is 117, (4,3) 107, (4,4) 97, (4,5) 87, (4,6) 78 and (4,7) 68. At (4,7) step 4 plays at 68; the other steps are unchanged.
steps.title: Walk down the velocity column

steps.caption: Tap range-down (16,8): the window moves down one level. Tap (4,1): step 4 plays at 117, the level that was second from the top. Play, then Stop. Tap range-down again and tap (4,1): 107. Then tap range-up (15,8) to move the window up one level and tap (4,1): 117 again.
steps.title: Move the velocity range

steps.caption: Hold range-down (16,8) for about a second: the window jumps to the lower page, 58 at the top down to 0 at the bottom. Tap (4,1): step 4 plays at 58.
steps.title: Jump to the lower page

steps.caption: Tap down the column of step 4 to (4,4), playing after each tap: (4,2) is 48, (4,3) 39 and (4,4) 29. At (4,4) step 4 plays at velocity 29.
steps.title: Go quieter

steps.caption: Tap down to (4,5) and (4,6), playing after each tap: (4,5) is 19 and (4,6) is 9. At velocity 9 step 4 still sounds, only very softly: all four notes are in the MIDI strip.
steps.title: Almost silent

steps.caption: Tap (4,7), velocity 0, and play. Step 4 is silent: the MIDI strip, "MIDI sent in this step", shows only three notes, 60, 62 and 64. A velocity of 0 turns the attack into a rest.
steps.title: Turn an attack into a rest

steps.caption: Tap range-down (16,8) again: the window is already at its lowest page, so (4,7) is still velocity 0 and step 4 stays silent. Then hold range-up (15,8) for about a second: the window jumps back to the top page, 127 down to 68. Tap (4,1): step 4 plays again at velocity 127.
steps.title: Restore full velocity
